title: Integrated AI Systems Capstone: The Autonomous Enterprise Agent
core_invariant: An enterprise AI agent is an evaluated, observable, safety-bounded state machine capable of autonomous reasoning and tool use.

stages.title: Capstone System Architecture
stages.instructions: Review Flagship V12 Operations Intelligence System combining SQL generation, semantic search, and tool-using incident agents.

stages.title: Multi-Agent Control Flow Diagram
stages.instructions: Map communication boundaries between planner, SQL specialist, and human-in-the-loop review nodes.

stages.title: Build Autonomous Execution Loop
stages.instructions: Implement the ReAct planning cycle with tool call retry and validation error feedback.

stages.title: Chaos Day: Malicious Prompt Injection & Tool Poisoning
stages.instructions: The incident agent encounters indirect prompt injection inside a log file attempting data exfiltration. Implement input sanitization and tool permission guardrails.

stages.title: No-AI Autonomous Agent Benchmark
stages.instructions: Build and evaluate an end-to-end multi-step financial reconciliation agent on a fresh API environment without AI assistance.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Agent passes 100% of safety guardrail tests and resolves multi-step task in < 6 iterations.

stages.title: Architectural Decision Record (ADR-042)
stages.instructions: Author ADR-042 justifying the agent memory hierarchy and failure fallback strategy.

stages.title: Flagship V12 Release Tagging
stages.instructions: Tag Flagship Release V12 and export the final Capstone Systems Portfolio.

stages.title: Final Capstone Gate Certification
stages.instructions: Perform final comprehensive audit of all 76 competencies and issue Level 5 AI Systems Architect Certification.
